system: ESCG Tour Acquisition — Event-Driven Production Loop
objective: Generate qualified voluntary senior-living tour inquiries for Evanston/North Shore families, without pretending inquiries are confirmed tours.

authority.github_loop: May autonomously research, verify, analyze, prepare drafts, and make isolated, tested GitHub changes or review PRs in scope.
authority.external_messages: NOT OWNED BY THIS LOOP while existing session operator is active. Prepare drafts/proposals; no sending, posting, joining groups, or making commitments.
authority.site_publication: Do not merge to main, publish, or deploy. Keep tested code improvements in separate review PRs unless authority is explicitly transferred.
authority.excluded: No spending, invented claims, protected personal data, client records, privacy/form changes, employer endorsements, or safeguards bypass.

baseline.prior_outreach: Ten organizational emails reportedly sent (operator state summary counter lags its action log). Recheck actual Gmail Sent before any future outreach.
baseline.tour_requests: 0 reported; not independently confirmed by this setup
baseline.demand: Single-digit attributable real visitors in prior operator review; traffic acquisition is the immediate bottleneck.
baseline.recent_work: Complaint and Medicare guide tour pathways improved Nov 18; don't duplicate.

completed.task: Find one genuinely new, relevant Evanston/North Shore referral or caregiver-resource placement opportunity that has an explicit public resource submission process or a verified official organizational general contact route. Compare against existing outreach records before recommending anything. Produce source-backed opportunity notes and an actionable next step for the designated outreach operator. Do not send.
completed.done_when: One verified, previously uncontacted high-fit opportunity with actual requirements and a concrete proposal, or a documented DROP with sources and no fabricated contact data.
completed.opportunity: Village of Skokie Health and Human Services, Human Services division (information and referral on local senior programs, village social workers, Senior Reassurance, SHIP)
completed.result: Verified previously uncontacted, high-fit municipal senior-services referral point in the town adjoining Evanston, matching the operator's 'township and village senior services' priority and the precedent of the Highland Park, Lake Forest and Morton Grove sends. Domain not among the 10 contacted domain hashes; Gmail search for skokie returns only Nextdoor digests (no sent mail, no decline). The division has no general mailbox: the official department directory lists individual staff addresses, of which the Program Specialist role is the appropriate single recipient (same pattern as E-1118-07/08 'published staff contact').
completed.requirements: No resource-submission form. One email to one published staff address only; disclosed independent site with the senior-living employment tie; offer the free tour checklist and cost/Medicare guides for families they refer; no request to endorse; ?ref=em-skokie-<MMDD> tag; never also email the social workers.
completed.proposal_for_operator: After the 19-20 Nov reply review clears the next small batch, send one disclosed note to the Program Specialist address on https://www.skokie.org/directory.aspx?did=20 (phone 847-933-8208 for a call-list fallback). This loop sent nothing and created no Gmail draft (drafts were previously sent by an unknown actor, B-1112).
also_checked_low_fit: Skokie Public Library: Health & Wellness info guide lists only government/national authorities (CDC, NIH, NIA, IDHS, HFS); no older-adult category; general address exists but placement unlikely. https://www.skokielibrary.info/info-guides/health-wellness
Wilmette Public Library: no older-adult resource page and no published email (phone/contact page only). https://www.wilmettelibrary.info/
Niles Township government site: no senior-services page or general email found on the home page.

completed.task: Use current evidence, not historical guesses, to identify the highest-intent search landing page where a small, factual change could make a real family more likely to reach the tour request. Inspect the actual deployed page and current code. Do not duplicate Nov 18 complaint/Medicare fixes or publish new unverifiable care claims. If there is a measurable defect, prepare a separate tested review PR, not a direct publish.
completed.done_when: Reproducible conversion/search issue with a verified small fix in a review PR and checks, or explicit evidence why changing pages is currently low-value.
completed.result: Search Console 16 Nov: illinois-medicaid-estate-recovery is the best-ranked page (avg position 5.8) and was the only page-one guide lacking the tour checklist + disclosed tour link (complaint and Medicare guides got it 18 Nov). Added the identical existing block after 'Where this fits with the rest of this site'; no new claims, data or form changes.
completed.verification: build-guides.py rebuilt only that guide; check-guides.js 2697/2697; test.js 768/768; check-citations.sh 15 dead citations, none touched by this change (the sandbox network is a likely cause, unconfirmed)

completed.task: Identify one practical free distribution channel with clear evidence of families choosing senior care, rather than repeating low-yield general Facebook scans. Prefer legitimate public directories, community resource listings, and older-adult service referrals. Evaluate suitability and eligibility honestly.
completed.done_when: One verified channel proposal with a no-cost authorized execution route or a sourced reason to drop the channel.
completed.channel: Evanston Care Network (City of Evanston social-care directory, launched May 2020 on Aunt Bertha, now findhelp)
completed.result: DROP. (1) evanstoncarenetwork.org now serves only a JS redirect to /lander (parked-domain pattern), so the city-branded directory is not a live channel. (2) The underlying findhelp platform lists 'non-profit organizations or local, state, or federally funded agencies that provide free or reduced cost services'; ESCG is an independent informational site with a disclosed senior-living employment tie and a tour option, so it does not qualify and a suggestion would misrepresent it. No submission made or proposed.
sources: curl https://evanstoncarenetwork.org/ on 2026-11-19 -> 200 with window.location='/lander' only
completed.side_leads_not_acted: Wilmette Public Library has a senior-services librarian and hosts caregiver programs (domain not in contacted hashes) but no public resource list; possible ACQ-001 input only, needs a general/role address check.

next_work_source: Reassess latest outcomes, shared operator state and source evidence after every task. Add a new task only when its expected tour-acquisition value and evidence justify it. Queue is empty after ACQ-001: the next run should add an item only for genuinely new evidence (an organization reply, E1 +48h verdict on 20 Nov 17:44Z, new Search Console data) and otherwise stop without committing.
